name: inspire-that-deck
description: Ideas, not a template, for cute HTML slide decks: principles for picking an element from the slide's own content, plus a live gallery of 12 single elements (scrapbook tape, polaroids, sticky notes, stamps, stickers, a tick-live checklist; cozy-quest pixel mascot, dialogue box, XP bar, inventory slots, loot reveal), each with when it fits, when to skip it and what it must keep.
